issue.title: Authentication failed
issue.markdown_message:
**Acme, Inc.**'s personio HRIS integration failed authentication. This is often invalid, expired, or revoked credentials, but it can also be temporary provider downtime.

Check the [logs](https://app.kombo.dev/env/production/integrations/personio:CBNMt7dSNCzBdnRTx87dev4E/logs) first. If the credentials look invalid, create a reconnection link from the [integration page](https://app.kombo.dev/env/production/integrations/personio:CBNMt7dSNCzBdnRTx87dev4E) so the customer can reconnect.
